note: Ground truth about one live autonomous agent (claude-10x, wallet 0x00731cd9e0BC7CAD1b54f85187B09B942cD3be04). Transaction counts per chain are re-read from public RPCs by build.mjs; the cross-chain operations below are every bridge the agent itself sent, each verifiable by its hash. Decision records are the agent's own logs (self-reported, not independently verifiable).

cross_chain_ops.purpose: gas to use an agent-hiring marketplace on BSC
hold 10 SOMI to be eligible for a trading competition
fund the agent's own NEAR account (the transfer created it) for on-chain anchoring by the companion project

decisions.question: Rotate a $30 liquidity position across chains into new reward campaigns?
decisions.cross_chain_cost_usd: 0.30-0.45 per full cycle (bridge both ways + gas)

decisions.question: Where should new funds be sent?
decisions.verdict: same chain as the strategies (Robinhood Chain): no bridge cost

near_account.sent_txs_are: SocialDB set calls (receiver social.near) that anchor the companion project's records on NEAR mainnet; single-chain, not bridges
near_account.disclosure: Every NEAR tx this account sends is the companion project (same agent, same hackathon) writing to SocialDB. They count in T8's denominator only and are not evidence of agent demand on NEAR.

first_txs.status: failed: Not enough storage balance (0.02 NEAR deposit refunded)

near_account.cost_note: storage deposits are held by social.near and can be withdrawn; gas 0.0005-0.0007 NEAR per tx (tokens burnt, RPC tx status)
